text:
Jamal: Heads-up — getting an alert storm for missing child spans from payments svc right after the 02:20 deploy. Sampling unchanged but whole subtraces are incomplete. Exporter error rate spiked. Anyone oncall can look?
Anya: Saw that too. otel-muxer logs show a pattern: `queue full, dropping batch` + upstream 429s from telemetry-proxy.
Olga: I'm on it, grabbing logs and hitting the proxy. curl looks slow but not entirely down.
Jamal: pasted a tail of the muxer logs: ```
muxer: enqueue failed: queue full (len=1024)
muxer: dropped batch id=0x7f3a err=queue_full
exporter: http 429 from telemetry-proxy /v1/spans
```
Kiara: FYI we rolled the span buffer TTL down to 1m in the canary earlier to reduce mem. That could make queues more bursty but shouldn't cause immediate drops like this.
SRE Bot: Created INC-4879 and assigned eng-oncall. :rotating_light:
Anya: Quick mitigation — toggled muxer into passthrough mode for the canary (no batching) to avoid queue head-of-line blocking. After the patch I see exporter latency decrease and fewer dropped batches.
Jamal: Nice. Still seeing some traces with missing `traceparent` headers though — could be header trimming somewhere upstream.
Olga: Found nginx proxy was injecting large cookies for a subset of requests; when header size > 8k it dropped non-whitelisted headers. Reproduced locally and saw `traceparent` stripped. Patch ready to preserve tracing headers in proxy config.
Kiara: Actions to follow: 1) increase muxer queue and add exponential backoff on 429, 2) revert the aggressive TTL canary or make it opt-in, 3) add alert on muxer queue saturation and on sustained exporter 429 rate, 4) add an ingress test that validates `traceparent` survives cookie bloat cases.
deploy-bot: deploy started: proxy-config-2026-03-20-preserve-traceparent -> canary (k8s)
Anya: After the proxy patch and muxer passthrough we see 90% reduction in dropped span batches and traces are looking whole again. Still monitoring. :eyes: 
Jamal: Thanks team. We'll follow up with a RCA doc (eng-platform + eng-runtime) and roll a long-term change: smarter muxer backpressure + telemetry-proxy rate limits + clearer retention docs.
Olga: I'll open the PR for the nginx header preserve and include the reproducer.
Kiara: I'll own the alerting + playbook updates.
SRE Bot: INC-4879 updated: mitigated -> monitoring.
Jamal: Closing thread for now but keep an eye overnight; ping here if something regresses.
